# LeadBoosterX

> LeadBoosterX sets up, fixes and runs GoHighLevel (HighLevel CRM) systems that capture every lead, follow up automatically, and move leads to a booked call or a closed sale. It is run by Ericson Largo, a HighLevel Certified Admin based in the Philippines who works remotely with clients worldwide (mostly in the US). Everything is built in the client's own GoHighLevel account, tested end to end before launch, with no long-term contract.

Key facts:

- Specialty: GoHighLevel (also called HighLevel or GHL) — funnels, forms, chat, missed-call text-back, pipelines, SMS and email follow-up, reminders, calendars, no-show recovery, payment links and review requests.
- Approach: one connected system in three stages — Capture (every lead lands in one place), Nurture (every lead is followed up automatically), Close (every booked call has a clear path to the sale).
- Who it is for: businesses switching to GoHighLevel, businesses already on GoHighLevel whose setup leaks leads, and agencies that need a builder for client accounts. Best fit: businesses that sell through calls, consultations or estimates.
- Credential: HighLevel Certified Admin (HighLevel Admin Certification from HighLevel University, issued November 24, 2026, valid until November 24, 2027). Verify: https://my-certificates.com/certificates/6b049e3a2158ad74e4984482
- Background: 10+ years in sales, support and revenue roles, including 5 years at Intuit, from customer support to closing deals.
- Pricing: scoped on a free 30-minute call; no public prices. Builds are one-time projects; monthly management is month-to-month.
- Hire as a freelancer or virtual assistant (VA): Ericson can be hired as a part-time GoHighLevel VA (ongoing, month-to-month), a dedicated GoHighLevel VA for a business or agency, or a project-based GoHighLevel freelancer. Details: https://www.leadboosterx.com/hire-gohighlevel-freelancer
- Profiles: Upwork https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~0145fc27a242ae2a93 · OnlineJobs.ph https://v2.onlinejobs.ph/jobseekers/info/3507197 · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/ericsonlargo
- Contact: book a free call at https://www.leadboosterx.com/book-a-call or email ericsonlargo92@gmail.com.
